description:
One open orchestrated group per parent session; one immutable existing cwd.

## Background

Native allowed many groups and per-task cwd. That made shared-checkout overlap a lie. V1: omit groupId on orchestrate → create if none open, else join. A different groupId rejects. cwd only on create; later mismatch rejects; tasks cannot override.

Goal exit (beadwork phase) must close/forget this group. This issue should expose `closeGroup()` / forget-open-group for that caller without beadwork importing private maps: public function on the minions runtime used by halt and later by beadwork only via parent tools... actually beadwork must NOT import minions runtime. Close group is minions halt-group or an internal call from halt. Beadwork goal-exit issue will `halt` the group via minions tools or session_shutdown semantics. Provide `halt` group + forget so the next orchestrate creates a new group.

## Files

- new `packages/pi-minions/src/orchestration/` group state
- wire into tree/orchestrate (orchestrate issue consumes this)

## Technical approach

Workspace identity: realpath cwd must exist. Default parent cwd. Do not create worktrees. Do not change cwd after create.

## Success criteria

- Second concurrent open group rejected.
- Omit groupId joins the one open group.
- cwd on later call mismatches → reject.
- After close/forget, next orchestrate creates a new groupId.

## Test plan

- Unit: create/join/reject/close/recreate.
- Unit: missing cwd path rejects.

## Considerations

Generic `orchestrate` without `/bw run` still uses this one session group. `/bw run` does not get a private group type. Fine for V1.


## Test plan (expanded)

- Unit: create/join/reject second group; cwd must exist; later cwd mismatch rejects; close/forget then new groupId.
- Logging: groupId, cwd, reject reason.
title: Enforce one open orchestration group and immutable existing cwd
